The BLM *organization* is American. 

The fight against anti-Black racism, which is now colloquially known as #BlackLivesMatter, is a global fight that dates back generations. Draymond wasnt asking about the organization, he was asking why we care because racism isnt here.
The people who celebrate this bullshit and the people who believe #BlackLivesMatter protesters should be brutalized is a perfect circle.
